map.💡 Friis 公式：Pr = Pt + Gt + Gr − FSPL；FSPL: 💡 Friis formula: Pr = Pt + Gt + Gr − FSPL; FSPL(dB) = 20·lg(d_km) + 20·lg(f_MHz) + 32.44. Setting Pr = receiver sensitivity gives the max line-of-sight distance d = 10^((Pt+Gt+Gr−Pr−20·lg(f)−32.44)/20) km.

map.算法（Friis）：EIRP = 发射功率 + 发射增益；链路预算 = 发射功率: Algorithm (Friis): EIRP = transmit power + TX gain; link budget = transmit power + TX gain + RX gain − receiver sensitivity; FSPL(dB)=20log10(d_km)+20log10(f_MHz)+32.44; solve back d_km = 10^((budget−20log10(f)−32.44)/20); wavelength λ=300/f (m).
map.例：20dBm、5.8GHz、收发各 3dBi、灵敏度 −90dBm → EIR: Example: 20 dBm, 5.8 GHz, TX/RX 3 dBi each, sensitivity −90 dBm → EIRP=23 dBm, budget=116 dB, distance≈2.6 km, λ≈5.2 cm. If 30 dBm, 2.4 GHz, 5 dBi each, −100 dBm → budget 140 dB, distance≈99.5 km, λ≈12.5 cm.
map.这是自由空间距离，现实更远还是更近？: Is this free-space distance longer or shorter in reality?
map.通常更近。Friis 仅算自由空间路径损耗，实际还有遮挡、多径、大气与馈线损耗；: Usually shorter. Friis computes only free-space path loss; real links also have blockage, multipath, atmospheric, and feeder losses; in mountains / indoors use a more conservative model (e.g. ITU-R empirical model).
map.频率越高距离越短？: Does higher frequency mean shorter distance?
map.同预算下 FSPL 随频率升高而增大，故高频（如 5.8GHz）比低频（如 91: At the same budget, FSPL grows with frequency, so high bands (e.g. 5.8 GHz) reach less far than low bands (e.g. 915 MHz); the higher band buys more bandwidth, which must be traded off.
